summary: All four subsections cover plan migration and configuration within the assigned scope. Vendor descriptions and ISO APG guidance are correctly attributed and distinguished from verified evidence. Each subsection includes the required workflow elements (roles, inputs, decisions, records, exceptions) and an illustrative example using a hypothetical scenario. The two permitted source URLs are used appropriately and each citation is supported by the research record. No FAQ sections are present, which is correct as none are assigned. There are no unresolved findings from the previous review, and the changed paragraphs introduce no new problems. The page passes all checks.
recordNames: Inventory identifying candidate map, purpose, scope, source location, and decision owner
Preparation record identifying source, expected scope and relationships, permitted sample, and known limitations
Acceptance decision record identifying reviewers, checks performed, discrepancies, and conditions for proceeding
Recovery plan identifying fallback source, decision authority, and discrepancy recording process
Transition decision record identifying accepted fallback source and person authorized to activate it
decisions: Determine ownership, acceptance and next action for each candidate map
Classify each candidate as ready for pilot, needing clarification, or retained for reference only
Decide which copy is applicable when several copies appear to describe the same work
Decide whether the pilot represents one site or a common process with local detail
Decide whether an item is unsuitable for the pilot until an open question is answered
Decide whether to accept the pilot result or escalate a discrepancy based on consequence for intended use
Decide whether a transition must wait when a readiness question is unknown
Return the transition decision to its authorizer if a later issue changes the accepted assumptions
